observations: The page number «46» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01: «mittlere Länge» continues «dieselben geben nämlich für die» at the end of p. 45 (JP2 0077, L35). L21-L22: the heading of chapter 10, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it.

L07: the formula is displayed in a line of its own, centred, the fraction built up, «e sin m» over «1 + e cos m», with a comma after it; L08: «5p 10′» over «60p», built up, the p raised; e and m in italics. Written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}.

L01-L02. Checked: 50° 44′ 20″ − 40° 56′ 38″ = 9° 47′ 42″; 314° 6′ 28″ (p. 42, JP2 0074, L35) + 9° 47′ 42″ + 6° 19′ 57″ = 330° 14′ 7″, 27′ short of al-Battānī's 330° 41′ (p. 45, JP2 0077, L35); the rest is in al-Battānī's increments for the 29 years, the month and the 14 days, which count from the equinox (p. 42, JP2 0074, L04-L05): at his precession of 1° in 66 years, 29 years add about 26′.

L03-L10. Checked: 60 sin 4° 56′ = 5p 9.6′ and 60 tan 4° 56′ = 5p 10.7′; 5p 10′ : 60p = 0.08611. With e = 0.08611 the formula of L07 gives 4° 55′ 18″ at 90° (arctan e) and its greatest value, 4° 56′ 24″ (arcsin e), near 95°, where cos m = −e; at 95° from the apogee, the anomaly of 265° of the example of p. 45, Suter reads 4° 54′ 52″ in Table 24 (p. 45, JP2 0077, N04). The rule sin q = sin 4° 56′ · sin m, whose greatest value 4° 56′ falls at 90°, gives 4° 54′ 52″ for m = 95°. To be compared with Table 24.

L25-L26: the apogees, set in six columns, the names over the values. Checked against the text of chapter 18 (pp. 14-15, JP2 0046-0047): Saturn eight signs 4° 55′, Jupiter five signs 22° 32′, Mars four signs 8° 24′, Venus two signs 21° 15′, Mercury seven signs 14° 54′, the sun two signs 17° 55′, that is 244° 55′, 172° 32′, 128° 24′, 81° 15′, 224° 54′ and 77° 55′. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|». L31-L32: the reading 15′ for 55′ of p. 43 (JP2 0075, N05-N08).

L11-L20, the transliteration as printed: «Taʿdīl», with the ʿayn raised and the macron; «al-khāṣṣa», «al-ḥāṣṣa», «al-ḥaraka al-khāṣṣa», «al-ḥiṣṣa», with the dots under ḥ and ṣṣ; «Tadil», «elheza», «elheca», the forms of the Latin text. L20: «Loos», as printed.

L24: the e of «Text» is a damaged sort, its eye partly missing; L30: the n of «in» is printed broken; N01: the note number 1 is printed broken, two small marks before the bracket; L31: the prime after «15» is a thinner, curved sort. Specks not transcribed: above «anom.» (L07), before «worin» (L08), before «hat» (L13), above the line after «Werte :» (L24) and after «wird,» (L27).

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Batt.», «Ptol.», «Ibn Hibintās», «Ibn Yūnus», «Burgess», «Thibaut», «Nallino»; italics: «m», «e», the Arabic and Latin words of L11-L20, «Anomalie» (L16), «Apogeen», «Praezession», «Sūrya-Siddhānta», «Panchasiddhāntikā», «Sindhind», and in N01 «the Panchasiddhāntikā of Varāha Mihira».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-14 px measured).
